1) PASS: The figure displays multiple colored per-class curves, a legend with "AP" values for each class, and dashed horizontal lines representing the no-skill baseline.
2) PASS: The "per class" line explicitly lists the classes (inactive, moderate, strong/weak) along with their corresponding Precision, Recall, F1, and sample size (n) metrics.
3) PASS: The button row clearly includes both the "ROC curves" and "PR curve" buttons.
4) PASS: All text elements, including labels, metrics, and legend entries, are fully legible without any overlapping or clipping.
